scoring_justification: Recomputing phonon DOS and elastic constants from the fitted ACE potential requires LAMMPS and phonopy, and extracting the eutectic from calphy free-energy simulations is computationally heavy; infeasible in the verifier sandbox. Agent-reported results are compared to the paper's ACE-specific reference values within tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for ACE validation and phase diagram features
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table II (elastic constants for ACE) and inferred phonon peak positions from Fig. 5; Table III (ACE column) for phase diagram features.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Elastic constants exactly as reported in the paper. Phonon peak positions read approximately from Fig. 5. Phase diagram features taken from the ACE column of Table III.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own ACE-potential results, the target quantities the reproduction must match.

outputs.description: Phonon DOS peak positions (THz) and elastic constants (GPa) computed from the fitted ACE potential.
Eutectic temperature (K), eutectic liquid Li fraction, and Li solubility in fcc Al at the eutectic temperature, extracted from common tangent constructions on the free-energy data.

output_contract.notes: Scoring uses exact_match with tolerances against the paper's reference values. The hidden checker compares the reported numbers to the gold values within tolerances (elastic constants 20%, peak positions 1 THz, eutectic temperature 50 K, composition/solubility 0.05 fraction).
